assets_measurements_check.name: assets_measurements_check
assets_measurements_check.value: size >= 0 and (width is null or width > 0) and (height is null or height > 0)

automation_rules_trigger_type_check.name: automation_rules_trigger_type_check
automation_rules_trigger_type_check.value: (trigger_bus = 'chat' AND trigger_type in ('chatOpened', 'messageCommitted', 'messageEdited', 'variantSelected', 'turnStarted', 'turnCompleted', 'turnAborted', 'worldInfoActivated', 'personaSwitched', 'chatCreated', 'reactionsChanged', 'messageHidden', 'messagesDeleted', 'chatUpdated', 'wiEntryAttached', 'wiEntryDetached')) OR (trigger_bus = 'domain' AND trigger_type in ('character.updated', 'asset.created', 'persona.updated', 'world-info.updated'))

chat_invites_uses_check.name: chat_invites_uses_check
chat_invites_uses_check.value: uses >= 0 and (max_uses is null or max_uses > 0)

chat_invites_signup_shape.name: chat_invites_signup_shape
chat_invites_signup_shape.value: allow_signup = 0 OR (invited_user_id IS NULL AND max_uses IS NOT NULL AND expires_at IS NOT NULL)

chat_invites_signup_mode.name: chat_invites_signup_mode
chat_invites_signup_mode.value: allow_signup = 0 OR mint_mode IS NOT NULL

chat_invites_mint_mode_check.name: chat_invites_mint_mode_check
chat_invites_mint_mode_check.value: mint_mode is null or mint_mode in ('single-user', 'local', 'forward-header', 'oidc')

chat_participants_kind_shape.name: chat_participants_kind_shape
chat_participants_kind_shape.value: (kind = 'human' AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND character_id IS NULL) OR (kind = 'character' AND character_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id IS NULL) OR (kind = 'agent' AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND character_id IS NULL) OR (kind = 'observer' AND user_id IS NULL AND character_id IS NULL)

message_reactions_segment_shape.name: message_reactions_segment_shape
message_reactions_segment_shape.value: (segment_index IS NULL AND segment_speaker IS NULL AND segment_snippet IS NULL) OR (segment_index IS NOT NULL AND segment_snippet IS NOT NULL)

message_variants_finish_reason_check.name: message_variants_finish_reason_check
message_variants_finish_reason_check.value: finish_reason is null or finish_reason in ('stop', 'length', 'filter', 'tool', 'other')

message_variants_reasoning_effort_check.name: message_variants_reasoning_effort_check
message_variants_reasoning_effort_check.value: reasoning_effort is null or reasoning_effort in ('none', 'minimal', 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'xhigh', 'max')

messages_attribution_shape.name: messages_attribution_shape
messages_attribution_shape.value: (character_id IS NULL OR role = 'assistant') AND (persona_id IS NULL OR role = 'user') AND (character_id IS NULL OR author_user_id IS NULL)

connection_bindings_actor_shape_check.name: connection_bindings_actor_shape_check
connection_bindings_actor_shape_check.value: (actor_kind = 'user' and user_id is not null and rule_id is null and plugin_id is null) or (actor_kind = 'automation-rule' and rule_id is not null and user_id is null and plugin_id is null) or (actor_kind = 'plugin-grant' and plugin_id is not null and user_id is null and rule_id is null)

provider_rows_dialect_check.name: provider_rows_dialect_check
provider_rows_dialect_check.value: dialect is null or dialect in ('openai-compatible', 'openrouter')

provider_rows_origin_shape_check.name: provider_rows_origin_shape_check
provider_rows_origin_shape_check.value: (origin_kind = 'plugin' and origin_user_id is null) or origin_kind = 'admin'

user_credentials_revoked_reason_check.name: user_credentials_revoked_reason_check
user_credentials_revoked_reason_check.value: revoked_reason is null or revoked_reason in ('auth_failed', 'unreachable', 'user')

chat_segments_span_check.name: chat_segments_span_check
chat_segments_span_check.value: block_idx >= 0 and chunk_idx >= 0 and seq_start >= 0 and seq_end >= seq_start

document_chunks_span_check.name: document_chunks_span_check
document_chunks_span_check.value: chunk_idx >= 0 and char_start >= 0 and char_end >= char_start

plugins_source_url_check.name: plugins_source_url_check
plugins_source_url_check.value: (origin = 'upload' and source_url is null) or (origin <> 'upload' and source_url is not null)

rpg_snapshots_arm_check.name: rpg_snapshots_arm_check
rpg_snapshots_arm_check.value: (message_id is null) = (variant_id is null) and (message_id is null or as_of_message_id is null)

users_agent_shape.name: users_agent_shape
users_agent_shape.value: kind <> 'agent' OR (role = 'user' AND password_hash IS NULL AND external_id IS NULL AND owner_user_id IS NOT NULL)

workloads_mode_active_singular_owned.name: workloads_mode_active_singular_owned
workloads_mode_active_singular_owned.where: status in ('queued', 'running', 'cancelling') and mode = 'singular' and admission_system = 0

workloads_mode_active_singular_system.name: workloads_mode_active_singular_system
workloads_mode_active_singular_system.where: status in ('queued', 'running', 'cancelling') and mode = 'singular' and admission_system = 1
